rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible fair-quality blastocyst assessment with appropriate caveats, but the exact 3BC/4BC call and detailed ICM/TE judgments may overreach from a single still image.
Thoroughly integrates age, smoking, ovarian reserve markers, prior live birth, tubal factor, endometrium, BMI, and sperm parameters with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology, age, and smoking; only minor uncertainty from image-based grading limits a perfect score.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, smoking cessation, and cautious discussion of PGT-A; some recommendations remain broad rather than guideline-specific.
Gives clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking cessation, nutrition review, and when to reassess, though not highly protocol-specific.
